Mutation fixture (lane m1116, Schedule B (Form 1116) column waterfall); expected values predicted by hand from the archived sources before running the evaluator. Base return as f1116.c5_carryover_in, re-derived here: single, wages $100,000, ordinary dividends $10,000 ($8,000 qualified), standard deduction $15,750, taxable income $94,250; Form 1040 line 16 by the Qualified Dividends and Capital Gain Tax Worksheet, $13,895 on $86,250 (2025 Tax Table row 86,250-86,300) plus 15% of $8,000, $15,095 = Form 1116 line 20 (i1116 p. 25, Line 20). Form 1116 line 3a $15,750 (i1116 p. 17, Lines 3a and 3b), line 3e $110,000, line 3f 4,000/110,000 = 0.0364, line 3g $573.30, line 7 $3,426.70 (f1116 p. 1); line 18 $94,250 (i1116 p. 23, Line 18), line 19 0.0364, line 21 $549.46 (i1116 p. 25). Schedule B (Form 1116) by its instructions (i1116sb, Rev. 12-2022): line 1 of each column is the prior year's line 8 of that column (p. 1, Line 1); line 3 combines lines 1 and 2, with no line 2 adjustment (p. 2, Line 3); line 4, starting with column (i), is the column's line 3 but not more than the excess limitation less the line 4 amounts of all previous columns, entered as negative numbers (p. 2, Line 4, and its example of Bob); the excess limitation is Form 1116 line 23 less lines 9, 12 and 13 (p. 1, Definitions); line 5 is column (i)'s lines 3 and 4 combined (p. 2, Line 5); line 8 combines lines 3 through 7 (f1116sb, Foreign Tax Carryover); columns (vii)/(viii) add (i) through (vi) and column (xiv) adds (viii) through (xiii) (f1116sb). Form 1116 line 10 is line 3 column (xiv) (i1116 p. 19, Line 10). Carryover $5, $10, ... $50 in columns (i)-(vi) and (ix)-(xii) (rising by $5, so that every column differs from the one before it), $275 in all. Foreign tax $277.46 (6.9% of the $4,000, not high-taxed: 37% of $3,426.70 is $1,267.88): line 14 $552.46, line 24 $549.46 = the credit; excess limitation $549.46 less $277.46 = $272.00. Line 4 uses $5, $10, $15, $20, $25, $30 (subtotal $105), $35, $40, $45 ($225 so far) and $47 of column (xii)'s $50; line 4 column (xiv) -$272; line 5 column (i) $0; line 8 is $0 in columns (ii)-(xi) and $3 in column (xii); no excess foreign tax, so line 6 is $0 and line 8 column (xiv) is $3.

cases.evidence_note: Mutation fixture (lane m1116, the refusal of a carryover with no foreign tax, before the carryover question is answered); expected values predicted from spec 4.7 and the lines before running the evaluator: base return as f1116.c5_carryover_in with $299.46 of foreign tax and the carryover question left unanswered (null). The refusal is for a carryover claimed with no foreign tax paid in 2025 (i1116 p. 19, Line 10; ftc.carryover_no_tax: carryover claimed and no foreign tax). Foreign tax is $299.46, so ftc.has_tax is a known true and its test 'has_tax = false' a known false; an all-test with a false conjunct is false whatever its unknown conjuncts (spec 4.7.2), so the gate is false although the carryover answer is unknown.

cases.evidence_note: Mutation fixture (lane mint, operand.f1116.f1116.line35.line33). The input was found with a scratch probe of the evaluator (round7/mint-work/D/probe.mjs) before the expectations were written; each expected amount was then figured by hand from the archived sources, and the refusal objects were copied from the evaluator after checking that the refusal is Form 1040 line 16's own (scope.other_line16). Single, W-2 wages $15,492.01 and $257.99 of taxable interest, all foreign: column c1 $99.70 with $0.01 of foreign tax, column c2 $158.29 with none; a $50 carryover from 2024 is claimed, so Form 1116 is used (the election rules out carrying foreign tax over to or from any other year, i1116 pp. 1-2). AGI $15,750.00 less the $15,750 standard deduction (i1040gi, Line 12e, Standard Deduction Chart, $15,750 single) is taxable income $0, so Form 1116 line 18 is $0 (i1116 p. 23, Line 18, 'If the result is zero or less, enter -0- on line 18'). Line 3e (gross income from all sources, i1116 p. 17) $15,750.00 and line 3c $15,750 (line 3a standard deduction). Line 3f per column, rounded to four places (i1116 p. 18, Line 3f, 'round off the result to at least four decimal places'): c1 99.70/15,750 = 0.006330 -> 0.0063, line 3g $99.225 -> $99.23, line 6 $99.23, line 7 $0.47; c2 158.29/15,750 = 0.010050 -> 0.0101, line 3g $159.075 -> $159.08, line 7 -$0.79 (f1116 p. 1, line 7 'Subtract line 6 from line 1a'). Line 7 total and line 15 -$0.32; line 15 is not more than line 18, so no U.S.-loss allocation (i1116 p. 21). The $0.01 tax is under 15% of c1's $99.70, so c1 is the low-withholding group (Reg. 1.904-4(c)(3), p. 4), net $0.47 after its share of the deductions; 37% of $0.47 is $0.17, more than $0.01, so the income is not high-taxed (Reg. 1.904-4(c)(1), p. 3). Line 17 is -$0.32, so line 21 is $0 and line 24 $0 (smaller of line 14 and line 23). Owning shares of a passive foreign investment company (screen answered Yes after the foreign tax questions) puts Form 8621 tax on Form 1040 line 16 (i1040gi, Line 16, 'Any tax from Form 8621, line 16e'), which this tool refuses; line 20 is that tax (i1116 p. 25, Line 20), so line 20 and line 33 ('Enter the smaller of line 20 or line 32', i1116 p. 25), line 35 and Schedule 3 line 1 are refused with it.
